zero.purpose: Empty counts and arithmetic identity; not an outcome.

one.purpose: Counting and indexing; not an outcome.

maxRunMilliseconds.purpose: Documented engineering timeout per cloud subprocess; not a simulated value or claimed CTO ceiling.

ny-unemployment-2021.purpose: New York 2021 annual average, March 2, 2022 BLS vintage; aggregate condition only, never a personal draw.

md-unemployment-2021.purpose: Maryland 2021 annual average, March 2, 2022 BLS vintage; aggregate condition only, never a personal draw.

moore-primary-2022.purpose: Documented primary vote percentage; evaluator target only.

moore-general-2022.purpose: Documented general vote percentage; evaluator target only.

lbj-college-loan.purpose: Documented nominal 1927 dollar loan; not inflated into 2021 dollars.

house-minimum-age.purpose: Constitutional minimum age for U.S. House service.

president-minimum-age.purpose: Constitutional minimum age for presidential service.

bytesPerKiB.purpose: Node maxRSS is measured in kibibytes; report peak resident memory in bytes.
